data.name: impressions
data.title: Impressions
data.description: The number of times that your posts, stories, reels, videos and live videos were on screen, including in ads.

data.name: reach
data.title: Accounts reached
data.description: The number of unique accounts that have seen your content, at least once, including in ads. Content includes posts, stories, reels, videos and live videos. Reach is different from impressions, which may include multiple views of your content by the same accounts. This metric is estimated and in development.

data.name: profile_views
data.title: Profile visits
data.description: The number of times that your profile was visited.

data.name: website_clicks
data.title: Website link taps
data.description: The number of times that the link to your website was tapped.

data.name: total_interactions
data.title: Content interactions
data.description: The total number of post interactions, story interactions, reels interactions, video interactions and live video interactions, including any interactions on boosted content.

data.name: profile_links_taps
data.title: Profile links taps
data.description: The number of taps on your business address, call button, email button and text button.
